MedicalJobsAustralia.com     About the role

Join Wesley Mission Queensland as a Disability Support Worker in our Specialist Disability Accommodation (SDA) team.

This is hands-on, meaningful work where you support vulnerable people with disability to build independence in their everyday lives.

In this role, you will:

Led by Registered Nurses

Trained to practice High Intensity Supports (i.e. Dysphasia management, Epilepsy, Tracheostomy).

Provide personal care and daily living support (meals, hygiene, household tasks)

Support individuals to build independence and life skills

Assist with community access and participation

Work collaboratively with a team to deliver active supports and, person-centred care

What your day can look like

No two days are the same. You might:

Help someone cook their first independent meal

Support a resident to confidently leave home and access the community

Deliver responsive support to individuals with complex needs, ensuring they feel safe and supported.

Build trust through everyday routines, conversations, and shared activities

This is practical, real work where you can see the impact you make.

What's in it for you

Free secure on-site parking

Career progression across various "internal" disability support programs or the wider WMQ business

Ongoing training & development

Supportive team environment where colleagues' step in and help

Work for a values-driven not-for-profit organisation

Permanent DSW Pay Rates:

Mon-Fri (AM shifts): $36.22-hr

Mon-Fri (Afternoon shifts): $40.75-hr

Mon-Fri (Night shifts): $41.65-hr

Saturday: $54.33-hr

Sunday: $72.44-hr

Public Holidays: $90.55-hr

Sleepover allowance: $62.11

Let's be honest
This is a highly rewarding role within a complex support environment.

You'll work alongside people with diverse and sometimes complex support needs

Every day brings different situations and opportunities to make a difference

Building trust, skills, and independence takes time and consistency

The reward is seeing the progress people make and knowing you played a part in helping them achieve their goals

About you

We're looking for reliable, genuine people who want to build a career in disability support.

You will have:

A caring, respectful, and patient approach

Ability to stay calm under pressure

Strong communication and teamwork skills

A genuine interest in supporting people to live independently

Requirements

Certificate III in Individual Support (Disability) or equivalent

Current Australian Driver's Licence - with full comprehensive motor vehicle insurance

NDIS Worker Screening Clearance (or willingness to obtain)

Current First Aid & CPR

Strong written and verbal communication skills

About the service

Our Supported Disability Accommodation is more than a service - it's a home.

We focus on:

Supporting choice and independence

Building confidence through everyday routines

Creating a safe, consistent, and respectful environment

About Wesley Mission Queensland

Wesley Mission Queensland is a not-for-profit organisation supporting people across disability, aged care, mental health, and community services for over 100 years.

We focus on:

Practical, person-centred support

Building independence and wellbeing

Supporting our employees as well as the people we serve

-	Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline, or at least five years of relevant experience in lieu of formal qualifications. 

In this role your main responsibilities include:

-	Develop and implement marketing strategies to promote residential, commercial and off-grid solar systems, battery storage and related renewable energy solutions. 
-	Identify market opportunities across residential, commercial and remote solar markets through research, competitor analysis and customer insights. 
-	Plan, coordinate and optimise digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, email marketing, the company website and social media platforms. 
-	Monitor and manage advertising budgets, ensuring marketing expenditure delivers measurable enquiry, conversion and return-on-investment outcomes. 
-	Analyse campaign performance, customer behaviour, seasonal demand and government incentive changes to continuously improve marketing effectiveness. 
-	Maintain consistent brand positioning across digital platforms, customer communications, review sites and promotional materials. 
-	Collaborate with management, sales staff and manufacturers to support promotional campaigns, product launches and co-marketing initiatives. 
-	Produce and coordinate marketing content including website updates, case studies, newsletters, promotional materials and social media campaigns. 
-	Manage customer review programs, lead tracking, CRM reporting and marketing performance dashboards. 
-	Undertake market research to identify demand for solar systems, energy storage solutions, and related services
-	Advise on marketing mix elements including pricing, promotion, and distribution channels for solar products and services
-	Recommend pricing, promotional and customer engagement strategies to support business growth and increase market share. 

Skills, experience and attributes:

To be considered for this opportunity you must have:

-	Strong knowledge of digital marketing principles including Google Ads, Meta advertising, search engine optimisation (SEO), email marketing and social media marketing. 
-	Experience using Google Analytics, CRM systems and marketing reporting tools to evaluate campaign performance and customer engagement. 
-	Excellent analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work collaboratively across sales, management and external suppliers. 
-	Strong copywriting, content development and campaign management skills with excellent attention to detail. 
-	Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently and deliver marketing initiatives within agreed budgets and timeframes. 
-	Knowledge of renewable energy markets, consumer behaviour and digital lead generation strategies will be highly regarded.

Global Vision Recruitment on Behalf of Loginet Technologies Pty Ltd

Date Posted: 13th July 2026

Position: ICT Project Manager (ANZSCO 135112)

Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 per annum plus Superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: 217 Margaret St, Toowoomba City QLD 4350

Experience required: Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects

About Loginet Technologies

Loginet Technologies is an Australian technology consulting and digital transformation company committed to helping businesses leverage innovative technologies to improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainable growth. We deliver end-to-end ICT solutions across managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software and mobile application development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent business automation, DevOps, enterprise networking, telecommunications, digital transformation, infrastructure management, ERP and CRM solutions, and managed technology support. Our experienced team works closely with organisations across diverse industries to design, implement, integrate, and support secure, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions that drive business innovation and operational excellence.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to lead the successful planning, execution and delivery of complex ICT projects across software development, AI solutions, business automation, cloud services, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives.

Working closely with clients, business stakeholders and multidisciplinary technical teams, you will manage the complete project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the complete lifecycle of ICT projects from initiation through planning, execution, implementation and closure.

•	Lead software development, cloud migration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent automation and digital transformation projects.

•	Collaborate with clients to gather business requirements and translate them into successful project outcomes.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience delivering AI, Generative AI or intelligent automation projects.

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

We offer:

•	Competitive remuneration package

•	Ongoing professional development and certification support

•	Flexible working arrangements

•	Exposure to enterprise cloud, AI and digital transformation projects

•	Career progression opportunities

•	Supportive and collaborative team culture

Interested applicant may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

 About Bhagya Caring Pty Ltd 

 Bhagya Caring is a compassionate NDIS service provider dedicated to delivering person-centred support that empowers participants to live independently and with dignity. We are a small, supportive team that values respect, reliability, and genuine care. Our participant, Madhavi, is at the heart of everything we do – and we're looking for a dedicated support worker to join us on this journey.

	  Mealtime Support:  Meal preparation and assistance with eating and drinking
